gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-synonym: Synonym reads as a quiet stripe of ink with generous curves. Red Hat Display above it is a marker-bold heading with daylight inside each bend, so if the heading shrinks to body size it loses its punch.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-podkova: Oswald stacks its tightly knit rows with a confident, strong stance up top. And Podkova follows as a bookish serif whose broad c opening keeps long paragraphs inviting.
gen-almendra-display-gf-blinker: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display has a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut. But Blinker holds its line thickness steady and keeps its apertures open, which is what makes the sans easy to read.
gen-archivo-black-gf-esteban: Archivo Black lands with an urban, authoritative weight, its x-height filling the middle of every line. And Esteban moves through a long passage with gentle stroke modulation and a wide e, its oversized lowercase feeling refined.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-rhodium-libre: Confident and strong, Oswald packs its rows tightly together as a heading. Rhodium Libre brings the editorial, traditional text serif underneath, with brush ends lifted away before each curve closes.
gen-almendra-display-gf-carrois-gothic: Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut. Carrois Gothic sits below as a modern sans with a high-set x-height, though blowing it up large would flatten that gap.
gen-archivo-black-gf-faustina: Authoritative from the first word, Archivo Black is low in stroke contrast and generous with space around each letter. And Faustina carries a longer passage on bowls that thin gracefully, its open-jawed c reading like a classic serif.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-plus-jakarta-sans: Red Hat Display draws a contemporary, bold marker line with visible daylight inside every curve as the heading. Plus Jakarta Sans keeps the text precise.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-rokkitt: Oswald packs its rows tightly with real strength. Rokkitt follows as a bookish classic serif with a c as open as a bent paperclip, so shrinking Oswald down would lose that confident punch.
gen-almendra-display-gf-chivo: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary voice as the heading. Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps and lets daylight through every curve, a professional, approachable counterweight.
